name: Safety and control (cautious reader, long)
angle: A careful reader who checks the licence, the terms and the protection tools before depositing.
intent_summary: Detailed brand-review page about the Incaspin online casino for players from Poland, written for a careful reader: who runs the casino and under which licence, the fact sheet, registration with account security and verification, the responsible-gambling tools, the welcome package with its terms, other promotions and loyalty, payments with withdrawal timing in a table, the game library, providers, mobile installation, the sportsbook, support, a pros and cons table, an FAQ and a closing checklist. Page voice: precise and calm, sentences of about 20 words on average with a few short ones, paragraphs of three to four sentences; every advantage is followed by the condition or limit that goes with it, stated calmly and in the same detail as the advantage; a fact is followed by what it means in practice; one call to action only, at the welcome package. All brand facts come from the AffBulk knowledge base incaspin-new; nothing is claimed about the legal status of the casino in Poland.

the limitations of the same offer
blocks.summary: A table of advantages and limitations drawn only from facts stated elsewhere on the page, with a short commentary.
blocks.notes: A short lead-in sentence, then a Markdown table Pros | Cons (Polish header) with four to five rows. Pros come from the Brand Information: the multi-stage welcome package credited automatically, the broad game range (write only 'more than 5000 games', never 6000), 24/7 live chat and e-mail support, instant deposits for most methods, the progressive web app without an app store. Cons are stated calmly with the same level of detail: wagering of 35x on the second and third deposit bonuses (general bonus rules specify 40x unless stated otherwise), a withdrawal minimum between 50 and 120 EUR depending on country or payment method, deposited funds that must be wagered at least three times before withdrawal, support languages of English and other languages (do not claim Polish support). Do not claim that the Polish zloty is supported, do not invent any other pro or con and repeat no more detail than a table cell needs. One closing sentence says what to weigh first (the wagering terms against the game range). Do not mention promo codes.

blocks.summary: Five short answers: promo code, verification time, minimum withdrawal, self-exclusion and the age limit.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of exactly five items, each a bold question followed by a short answer of 20-30 words, in this order: (1) is a promo code needed for the welcome bonus (credited automatically, no code needed, entering a code for a Welcome Package bonus makes the player ineligible for it; never mention INC2 or INC3); (2) how long does identity verification take (most reviews take a few hours to one day); (3) what is the minimum withdrawal (between 50 and 120 EUR depending on country or payment method); (4) can a player exclude himself or herself: the question must contain the keyword "Inca Spin" in the form "konto Inca Spin" (exactly once in the block), the answer: from 3 months to 5 years or indefinitely, 6 months by default if no period is chosen; (5) who may register at the casino: the question contains the name Incaspin Casino (the one occurrence of "Incaspin casino"), the answer: adults aged 18 and over. The brand name "Incaspin" goes into one answer, not into a question. These are the only questions on the page; the questions are the one place where question form is allowed.
